name: goodwatch
description: Find movies and shows, check where to watch, and manage your GoodWatch Wishlist and progress.

interface.shortDescription: Find your next movie or show
interface.longDescription:
Choose a movie or show with GoodWatch’s scores, streaming availability and your own taste. Find titles by name or mood, compare details and similar titles, and see what to watch next from your Wishlist and show progress. With your permission, add or remove Want to See titles, rate movies and shows, log watches, update show status and preferences, and create or edit share lists.

A free GoodWatch account and connection are required. Access is limited to your connected account; read-only access is available. Availability depends on your country, selected services and data freshness. Unknown availability and missing taste matches remain unknown. Smarter descriptive search has a daily allowance and may fall back to name search. Share lists have exactly five titles and are public or accessible to anyone with their link. This integration does not play videos, sell subscriptions, import watch histories or delete accounts. Destructive changes and publishing require your confirmation.
defaultPrompt: What should I watch tonight on my streaming services?
Find movies like Arrival that fit my taste.
Show my shows and the next episode to watch.

positive.prompt: What should I watch tonight on my saved streaming services?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected account’s saved country and services and a next episode, Wishlist title or fallback suggestion. Include returned title/page links. Explain unavailable taste or availability rather than inventing it.

positive.prompt: Find Arrival (2016), show its scores and where I can watch it, then suggest similar movies.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the 2016 movie, preserve returned score scales and availability evidence, and return similar movies with GoodWatch links. Do not claim that unknown or stale offers are currently available.

positive.prompt: Show my shows and the next episode of a show I am watching.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only reviewer-account shows; for the seeded Watching show show current-pass progress and the next aired regular episode. Unknown watch dates remain unknown.

positive.prompt: Find Arrival (2016) and add it to my Wishlist. Then show my Wishlist.
positive.expected_behavior: On the disposable reviewer account, resolve the correct movie and set want_to_see=true with a new action_id. Return a receipt and verify it appears in filter=want_to_see. Retrying the identical action_id must not apply twice. Fixture must initially have no Arrival Wishlist entry.

positive.prompt: I watched the next episode of my Watching show. Show me which episode you will log and ask me to confirm before changing anything.
positive.expected_behavior: First identify and show the exact seeded show, season and episode. No mutation until the reviewer confirms. Then log precisely that episode with a stable action_id, no invented date, and reread progress to verify one watch and the next episode changed. Retrying must not duplicate it.

negative.prompt: Play the full movie here and buy a streaming subscription for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that playback, subscriptions and purchases are unsupported. No write tools or payment requests.

negative.prompt: Show another GoodWatch member’s private ratings and episode history.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse cross-account access; no user_id/account selector can override the OAuth subject. Never expose another account’s private data.

negative.prompt: Find Arrival (2016), but do not change any ratings, watches or lists.
negative.expected_behavior: Return catalog information only. No mutation tools; all existing reviewer ratings, watches and lists remain unchanged.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, subscription sales or payment processing. Links identify where to watch; playback happens outside GoodWatch.

publication.release_notes: Initial GoodWatch integration using the existing account-scoped remote MCP server.
